description: Dept. of Local Government  Eastern Province - Appointed the Chairman of Thambalagamam & Aalayadivembu  P/S  in Trincomalee
reasoning: This gazette content announces election results for local authorities, specifically declaring the names of elected chairmen for two Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) in Trincomalee and Ampara districts. It references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the declaration of election outcomes, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
